projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota facility
projects.quote: Applied Digital’s first facility is in Jamestown, North Dakota with capacity of 100MW.

projects.name: Jamestown facility Energy Services Agreement
projects.quote: Additionally, the facility is powered through a five-year Energy Services Agreement (ESA) with a local utility.

projects.name: Garden City, Texas facility
projects.quote: Applied Digital’s second facility is in Garden City, Texas, planned for capacity of 200MW.

projects.name: Ellendale, North Dakota facility
projects.quote: Applied Digital’s third co-hosting facility is in Ellendale, North Dakota with planned capacity of 180MW.

projects.name: Ellendale Energy Service Agreement
projects.quote: The Company previously entered into a five-year Energy Service Agreement (ESA) with a utility partner in Dickey County servicing Ellendale, North Dakota.

projects.name: Jamestown 5MW standalone HPC processing center
projects.quote: Construction started during the quarter on our specialized 5MW standalone processing center, adjacent to its existing 100MW Jamestown facility.

projects.name: Jamestown facility GPU deployment retrofit
projects.quote: The Company successfully retrofitted a small portion of its existing 100MW Jamestown facility to support a GPU deployment.
